    'gsm8k': ('exact_match,strict-match', 'GSM8K_em'),
}

snapshot = {
    'created_at': datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + 'Z',
    'metric_standard': {
        'PIQA': 'acc_norm', 'ARC-C': 'acc_norm',
        'WinoGrande': 'acc', 'TruthfulQA': 'mc2',
        'GSM8K': 'exact_match(strict-match)'
    },
    'data': {}
}

for f in sorted(glob.glob('*_eval.json')):

else:
